title: boehmeria virgata var. sumatrana
intro: Boehmeria virgata var. sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran nettle or Sumatran Boehmeria, is a type of plant that belongs to the nettle family (Urticaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria virgata var. sumatrana include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic actions, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
